ambient_events: A coke pile settles with a soft crunch and exhales a breath of sulphurous heat.
Deep in the char a red glow pulses once, like something down there is still awake.
description: A yard heaped with spent coke, the grey-black char raked out of the Slagworks' furnaces and dumped uphill to cool. It never fully does; deep in the piles a red heart still glows, and breathes.
name: Coke Yard
